title: The Hideaway at Home Sweet Hillsdale
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located studio apartment.  This private retreat offers a beautifully designed space for one or two people.  It is fully equipped with everything you need for living comfortably and peacefully, including covered parking.  A perfect get away for those coming to town for work or a shorter stay.  This sweet space is located 18 minutes from downtown Nashville and minutes from all conveniences Hendersonville has to offer, including the water.
